action: opened the order: Invent one new widget that goes beyond everything in the catalog. One remarkable idea, or none.
Untapped capability: proposed Earpiece (earpiece-widget), Fine print (fineprint-widget), Loupe (loupe-widget)
Person at the terminal: proposed Lens (lens-widget), Corners (corners-widget), Decisions (decisions-widget)
Delight: proposed Unsent (unsent-widget), Double take (doubletake-widget), Count to ten (tencount-widget)
took the order at ideation

stamped reject on "Fine print": An automatic aside-widget question in the calibration/proof/critic family, and it pays a cache-read of the whole context on every editing turn for a self-report nobody can check.
stamped reject on "Lens": The same widget as Loupe from the same order, widened with a port lookup that does not belong on the card.
stamped reject on "Decisions": The answered half of owed-widget and parking-widget: a log read once a month that nobody would mention to a colleague.
stamped reject on "Unsent": Keeping deleted drafts on screen costs more in privacy than a novelty line gives, and the rescue of a wiped draft is too rare to carry a card.
stamped reject on "Double take": A word-list match over the stream that stream-widget and marquee-widget already tap, noisy on ordinary uses of 'actually' and empty where thinking is not shown.
stamped reject on "Count to ten": Dropping a prompt on a capitals-and-punctuation guess makes every false hold cost the person a send, which is out of proportion to a joke told once.

stamped reject on "Loupe": Not chosen: a real new input (the mouse selection) but fullscreen only, its answer is a git grep guess at a definition, and it only looks things up where Earpiece changes how the work goes.

stamped reject on "Corners": Not chosen: useful, but it is a fixed pattern list over tool.call edits, the shape footprint, proof and todos already have, with false alarms on 'as any' and 'noqa'; it does not go beyond the catalog as the order asks.

stamped pass: Earpiece is the only idea that does something no widget and no part of the catalog can: read inside a running subagent and correct it without stopping the turn, at no token cost, on calls that all exist.
